correctness.rationale: For \(0<t<-\alpha\log\theta/(2\varphi)\), the one-step bolicity bound is exactly \(e^{2\varphi t}\theta^\alpha<1\), so the two-dimensional cocycle is strongly bunched. A period-\(n\) word with \(m\) zeros has gap \(2t|m-\varphi(n-m)|/n>0\) by irrationality. The Bernoulli measure with zero-symbol weight \(1/\varphi\) has both exponents zero, excluding domination by the uniform-gap consequence of domination.

value.rationale: This is a motivated sharpness boundary for a new periodic-gap theorem: it shows that the uniform constant cannot be weakened to pointwise positivity even under the theorem’s strongest low-dimensional regularity regime, in the minimum fiber dimension, and arbitrarily close to the identity. The zero-gap Bernoulli measure identifies the precise obstruction rather than merely recording failure of domination.
